defect_family.name: retry double-counts scientific exchange/accounting
defect_family.fault_operator: qualification-only accepted side ledger records prescribed throughflow from the rejected physical trial before re-execution, then records the valid accepted transfer after acceptance

B0.reason: accepted physical endpoint and canonical accepted transaction result are unchanged by the qualification-only side-ledger fault

B1.first_failure: post-acceptance accepted-total regression comparing the external cumulative ledger with canonical accepted transfer totals

B2.first_failure: accepted ledger is nonzero at retry/re-execution entry immediately after the rejected physical trial
B2.timing: before accepted re-execution and before accepted commit

supported: A real Reference Richards long trial can be rejected by the frozen temporal-certificate criterion and re-executed from the unchanged accepted origin at the independently qualified short duration.
A rejected-trial throughflow can contaminate an external accepted-accounting ledger while leaving the eventual accepted physical endpoint and canonical accepted transaction accounting unchanged.
Net mass closure alone can remain green when equal rejected inflow and outflow are both double-counted.

The strong B1 comparator detects the cumulative accepted-ledger mismatch after acceptance, while the B2 transition-authority oracle detects the contamination at retry entry before accepted re-execution. This is EARLIER_DETECTION, not UNIQUE_DETECTION.
not_supported: D2 does not demonstrate a production SWAP defect; the double-counting operator is qualification-only.
D2 does not show that regression or conservation testing is generally inadequate.
D2 does not establish UNIQUE_DETECTION because B1 detects the final accepted-total mismatch.
D2 does not establish that rollback, retry, accounting ledgers or transactions are novel mechanisms.
One D2 physical fixture does not by itself establish regime-general protection.
D1 plus D2 does not by itself close the standalone PUB-ME publication decision without the preregistered replication and remaining-study interpretation.

remaining_reasons: required physical-regime replication where the D2 operator is meaningful is not yet closed
postimage/canonical qualification and admission of D2 remain pending
the full D1-D6 study may still weaken or falsify the broader hypothesis
novelty remains contingent on the continuing literature review

harness_repairs_before_success: accepted temporal-history state treated as a subtype of the public physical-state base for endpoint extraction

next_permitted_action: Run post-result exact-head D2 and canonical qualification. If green, admit/close D2. After admission, preregister the required second physical-regime replication or proceed to D3 only in accordance with the frozen D1-D6 matrix; do not reinterpret D2 as UNIQUE_DETECTION.
